decision.reason: The detached launcher gave cancellation paths only to selected focused modes and omitted Stage2, while Stage2 and its native-exact workers had no cancellation parameters. A request therefore remained visible only to the supervisor. Its fixed 120-second deadline expired before the active self-host compile could finish safely, the supervisor published exit 124 and stopped observing the still-running target tree, and 14 process IDs became recorded orphans. Stage2 now propagates one exact request/run/ack contract through native-exact work, cancellation-enabled waits observe requests every 100 ms, acknowledgement temp files are runspace-unique, and the default Stage2 cooperative deadline is 3600 seconds unless explicitly overridden. Normalize retained historical verification observations to the existing record contract. Original JSON and terminal outputs remain preserved unchanged. Recorded baseline timeout/cancellation and orphan evidence is retained, not relabeled as current success. No current input compatibility, whole-goal acceptance, new test execution or speed claim.
